job.job_description:
Preferred candidate profile

Troubleshooting Skills 5 years: B1
Systematic debugging
Log analysis
Performance profiling
Incident response
Prompt Engineering – 2 years:
Prompt Design: effective prompts for different personas, tasks, schema & models
Few-shot & Zero-shot Learning: guide model behaviors
Building AI Agents 2 years:
Agent Frameworks: langchain, autogen, crewai, MCP, etc.
Memory & Context Management: long-term memory, RAG
Tool Use & Planning: Integrating external tools (API/DB), multi-step reasoning, task decomposition
State management: goal tracking, actions, outcomes
LLM Integration: using common open and closed models (OpenAI, Gemini, Anthropic, Llama, etc.)
Evaluation & safety: testing agent behavior, fail-safes, ethical constraints
Security: input sanitization, sensitive data handling, prompt injection projection, scoped permissions, logging, rate limiting
AWS Public Cloud Skills 3-5 years:
Core services: EC2, S3, Terraform/CloudFormation, Lambda, DynamoDB
AI services: Bedrock, Bedrock Agents
Security: IAM policies, roles, KMS, secrets manager
Database Skills 3-5 years:
SQL mastery: joins, indexing, query optimization
Data modeling: normalization, denormalization, er diagrams, schema design
Performance tuning: Query plans, caching strategies
Programming Languages 3-5 years:
Go
Python
Java
Terraform (nice to have)
